condition.instructions: Choose the primary operational condition in this metrics window.

criteria.healthy: All service and dependency measurements are within their normal ranges.
criteria.db_pool_pressure: Database connection-pool usage is saturated and requests wait for connections.
criteria.traffic_spike: Request volume increased without evidence of database pool saturation.
criteria.application_errors: Application failures increased without a saturated dependency resource.

impact.instructions: Score the operational impact of this metrics window.
